goal.objective: Deliver the owner-approved Vexel product: a high-quality macOS-first vector drawing and 2D animation application with a modern task-focused UI, faithful Inkscape SVG import/export and preservation, a versioned native project format for artwork/animation/assets, high performance on large documents, and live, observable, user-controlled MCP operation for Claude Code, Codex, and compatible agents. Update the governing product decision and roadmap, then implement the remaining capability in scoped repository work orders; reserve the comprehensive UI/end-to-end acceptance pass for the end while retaining focused correctness checks during implementation.
